authority: Owner said do it all after recommendation to backport both v15 retention fixes, replay final-v16 aging, compare three builds, pursue attributed improvements, characterize Angular and reconcile release docs.

aging.operations: Unchanged aging.mjs from the sealed packed-field-aging audit; six512-row stores, all row handles held; widths8/32 with6rounds per phase, width3 steady/promote with12rounds per phase. Retain actual row assertions, quiescence, collection sentinels and all phases.
aging.schedule: Each profile has two packed A/A then three alternating pairs;32fresh serial children; no retries or pooling with prior results.
aging.primary: Second-phase live heap above baseline; CPU/wall and other heap endpoints descriptive. Investigate large remaining live growth before selecting optimization.
aging.limits: Held-store working set is not a leak proof; tree collection does not prove every individual object collected. Finite edit rounds do not establish an unlimited-time plateau.

ordinary.operations: Actual app bodies, model/oracles and route/action counts from existing release-economics policy;1,000jobs,1,000products and mixed eight-store heap after9,600actions.
ordinary.schedule: Each profile has two originalv15 A/A then five balanced three-arm rounds;51fresh serial children. All inputs checked around every child. Originalv15 actual-resource retention failure is retained and may continue; repaired-arm failure aborts.
ordinary.limits: Common ordinary outcomes, not full semantic capability parity. Baseline collection failure remains a failure and is not converted to a pass.

direction: Comparison ranges must be disjoint and median gap exceed the largest observed A/A or arm range. Descriptive host evidence, not a confidence interval or population percentile.
binding: Exact package bytes, executed harness/helpers/app bodies, policy, Node/toolchain and host/load metadata.
optimization: Only implement a concrete attributed mechanism; preserve supported APIs, late acquisition, captured evidence, reentry, entity lifetime, live-subscriber behavior and original strict point bound. Keep each diagnostic/prototype cohort separate. Report regressions and feasible alternatives; no automatic v15 parity requirement or new threshold fitted to results.
heavyWork: Tests, builds, browser measurements, CPU/heap runs and mutation campaigns are serialized; source-only work may proceed except during mutation campaigns.
